## The same audit, in your language

From the audit you already run to the page you just published, OctoCheck speaks to whoever owns the fix.

### Take your audits into AI search

Run the same technical checks you already trust, now mapped to how LLMs crawl, parse, and cite a page. Spot what AI engines can and can't read before it costs you a citation. Every fix comes ranked by impact, so the highest-value work goes first.

### See what AI answers pick up, and why

Find out why AI answers surface your content or skip it, from citation-ready passages to coverage gaps and stale claims. Every issue comes with a plain-language fix you can ship yourself. No developer in the loop, no guesswork about what to change.

AI answers favour pages that resolve a question end to end. Expand the pricing section so the page fully delivers, no developer needed.

### Technical checks on any page, in seconds

Crawlability, schema, rendering, headers, and the accessibility tree agents actually read, all in a single pass on any page. Compare the raw HTML a bot fetches against the rendered DOM a person sees. Catch what client-side JavaScript hides from non-rendering crawlers.

### Know if AI can find and trust your site

Get one readiness score that tells you, in plain language, whether AI search can find, trust, and cite your site. Then work through the fixes that matter most first. Each one is explained simply, with no jargon and no guesswork about where to start.

Your site is in good shape for AI search. One fix to go, explained in plain language.
